results.name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity

definition.text: Modulates the activity of a cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase, enzymes of the protein kinase family that are regulated through association with cyclins and other proteins.
Cyclin-dependent catalysis of the reactions: ATP + protein serine = ADP + protein serine phosphate, and ATP + protein threonine = ADP + protein threonine phosphate.

results.name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity

definition.text: Binds to and stops, prevents or reduces the activity of a cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase.

results.name: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity

definition.text: Binds to and increases the activity of a cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase.
Modulation of the activity of the enzyme cyclin-dependent protein kinase activating kinase.
